## Core Venture Ecosystem (Portfolio Companies)
1. PEROIX (Web & Digital Presence)
   - Domain: https://peroix.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: High-conversion digital presence, elite clinic/doctor portals, and modern enterprise software.
2. VOIDEX (Frontier AI & Autonomous Intelligence)
   - Domain: https://voidex.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: Custom generative models, autonomous agent fleets, NATSU neural engines, and sovereign AI infrastructure.
3. MEETRIX (Creator & Executive Matchmaking)
   - Domain: https://meetrix.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: Intelligent matchmaking platforms connecting visionaries, venture leaders, and creator communities.
4. FOODTRAF (Subscription Dining & Micro-Logistics)
   - Domain: https://foodtraf.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: Urban subscription meal infrastructure, automated kitchen pipelines, and zero-waste dining networks.
5. LASHKARI MOBILITY (Clean Urban EV Transit)
   - Domain: https://mobility.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: Sustainable last-mile urban logistics, electric mobility infrastructure, and battery swapping ecosystems.
6. QUANT AUTOMATION (Proprietary Trading Systems)
   - Domain: https://quant.lashkarigroup.online
   - Focus: Low-latency algorithmic execution, statistical arbitrage, and real-time market micro-structure engines.
